svg.text: Direction: left → right · Two separate flows that only meet at the Vector DB
Offline runs on a schedule (e.g. nightly),
never while a user is waiting.
Use the SAME embedding model on both
sides, or the search will not match.
No good match → don't let the LLM guess.
Say so, and log it to find missing docs.
Token limit: the prompt must fit the
